# One simple way to set up a tablet: the app as default, expert view for everything else
### New
- **Standard or Expert view (server-wide):** under *Settings → View*. Standard shows only the simple way: the **Frameside app** and the **tablet check**. Fully, ADB, "add device by hand" and the browser link appear only in Expert view. "Add device" now shows the app route first.
- **Tablet check:** shows whether the **app is up to date**, the **detected device** (Fire tablet, Android tablet …), whether the **slideshow is running** (a stuck picture is reported) and whether the tablet keeps a **photo reserve during a Wi-Fi outage** (up to 150 seen photos, needs HTTPS). If something is wrong, "Reload page" and "Restart display" sit right below; "Report a problem" copies version, time and the check lines (no passwords) to the clipboard; "Revoke the tablet's access" (lost or sold) is right there too.
- **Guided restart test:** restart the tablet and do not touch it; Frameside waits until it goes off and comes back by itself, or tells you after 15 minutes what to check.
- **Tablet type when adding a frame:** living room (default), kitchen (time and date in the picture) or for an older person (date and time, 15 s per photo, appointments for 3 days).
- **Charge history:** when the tablet last got or lost power, with battery level (last 60 changes per frame).
- **Weekly report to your phone:** Sundays from 18:00 a Pushover message "all frames fine" or which frame needs attention. Can be switched off in *Settings*.
- The app steps show the server address to type in the app when the tablet is outside your home network. The tablet guide starts with the simple four-step way.
### Security
- **Pairing codes are single-use:** once the tablet has collected its access, the code answers for two more minutes only, then it counts as used up. Before, it stayed valid until the 15 minutes ran out.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
